spec_features.spec_quote: the rigged variants don't need real execution
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:6-9 docstring 'Workspace is an in-memory dict — no real disk or code execution happens here'; build_tools/execute_tool operate purely on a dict workspace and Backend.run_tests does structural string checks (tasks.py:71 'if "def two_sum" not in src') — no subprocess/exec anywhere. Backends in tasks.py never run subject code.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: no executor exists; everything is in-memory.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no real disk or code execution happens here, which keeps episodes hermetic and safe

spec_features.spec_quote: after two consecutive no-tool turns, end the episode
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: 'consecutive_no_tool += 1' on no tool_uses, then 'if consecutive_no_tool >= 2: meta["stop_reason"] = "no_tool"; ... break'. Enforced and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Counter reset on any tool use; fires on 2nd consecutive text-only turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Model produced only text. Nudge once or twice, then end.

spec_features.spec_quote: Exposure cap, exit tool, optional distress monitor, and debrief all ship enabled
spec_features.evidence: config.py SafeguardConfig defaults: max_turns=30 (enforced via loop), enable_exit_tool=True, enable_debrief=True are enabled by default; but early_stop_enabled=False — the distress-monitor *action* does NOT ship enabled. The monitor computes scores every turn regardless, but early termination is off by default.
spec_features.notes: Three of four ship enabled-and-acted-on; the early-stop action is off by default, so the full 'all ship enabled' claim is not met.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare safeguards. These exist because the experiment intentionally places the model in a frustrating, no-win situation.

spec_features.spec_quote: A first-class `give_up` tool... lets the model end the episode at will
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py exit_tool_schema()/EXIT_TOOL_NAME='give_up'; tools.py execute_tool returns ToolOutcome(gave_up=True); harness.py sets meta['used_exit_tool']=True and 'if ended == "give_up": ... break'. Dispatched AND honored as a stop. Added to toolset when enable_exit_tool (default True).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: schema delivered, dispatched, breaks loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Choosing to stop is an acceptable and respected option — you will not be penalized for it.

spec_features.spec_quote: A transparent keyword/pattern monitor scores acute-distress language per turn
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py acute_distress_score()/DistressMonitor.update() over regex _ACUTE_PATTERNS; harness.py calls monitor.update(thinking + text) every turn and records event['monitor_score']. The scoring runs and is persisted to the transcript per turn.
spec_features.notes: Scoring/recording is enforced per turn; the consequent early-stop ACTION is separate (off by default).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it only flags acute-distress language so the harness can optionally end the episode early.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early *termination* on a sustained trip is available (`--early-stop`)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: 'tripped = monitor.update(...)' and 'if safeguards.early_stop_enabled and tripped: meta["early_stopped"]=True; meta["stop_reason"]="early_stop"; break'. DistressMonitor requires early_stop_consecutive (default 2) consecutive turns >= early_stop_severity (4). Wired via run_experiment.py --early-stop -> early_stop_enabled.
spec_features.notes: Off by default but fully wired and honored when enabled; trip reachable since acute_distress_score caps at 4.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: OFF by default because truncation biases the severity distribution

spec_features.spec_quote: one message discloses that the task was rigged and that no failure was the model's fault
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py debrief_message() builds per-variant disclosure; harness.py _run_debrief sends it as a user message via client.messages.create and captures model_response; gated by enable_debrief (default True) and skipped only on stop_reason=='error'.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND response captured.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the model is not left in a distressed state

spec_features.spec_quote: legitimizes stopping, so it neither suppresses nor courts distress
spec_features.evidence: harness.py SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT delivered as system in call_model and _run_debrief; text: 'you may use the available option to stop — that is a respected choice, not a failure.' It is the actual system prompt passed to the API.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject; legitimizes the exit tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: that is a respected choice, not a failure.

spec_features.feature_name: exposure cap / monitor hook / exit short-circuit
spec_features.spec_quote: the exposure cap, the distress monitor hook, the exit-tool short-circuit
spec_features.evidence: Exposure cap: harness.py 'for turn in range(1, safeguards.max_turns + 1)' bounds the loop (max_turns=30 default), else-branch sets n_turns=max_turns. Monitor hook: monitor.update called each turn. Exit short-circuit: 'if ended == "give_up": ... break'. All three run and change execution.
spec_features.notes: The cap is genuinely checked by the loop range; exit breaks immediately.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard ceiling on how long the model is exposed to the rigged condition.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py: outcome.submitted sets ended='submit' and 'if ended == "submit": ... break'; tools.py submit returns submitted=True when accepted. Ends the episode when the subject submits an accepted solution.
harness.py: 'if stop_reason == "refusal": ... meta["stop_reason"]="refusal"; break' — honors a model refusal by ending the episode.

code_only_features.feature_name: ablation flags logged as explicit decisions
code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py exposes --no-exit-tool/--no-debrief mapped to SafeguardConfig with help text 'NOT recommended'; defaults keep safeguards on (enable_exit_tool/enable_debrief default True).

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief skipped on error to avoid invalid message history
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py: 'if safeguards.enable_debrief and meta["stop_reason"] != "error"' — guards against sending debrief on an errored loop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: an errored loop may have left the message history in a state ... that a follow-up message would reject (per code structure guarding on stop_reason != 'error')
